Aster Observatory: Aster Observatory is a fictional observatory used in a software exercise. It opened in 1982. It is located on North Ridge. Its main instrument is a small telescope. It hosts student visits. Its designer was Mira Vale.
Mira Vale: Mira Vale is a fictional architect. Mira Vale was born in Lumen. She designed Aster Observatory.
North Ridge: North Ridge is a fictional location used only in this exercise. It is located in Velora.
Lumen: Lumen is a fictional country used only in this exercise.
